Dear Sir or Madam,

Thank you for your enquiry. Please find our Angebot below.

We offer a price of €438.21 per unit, a volume of 4580 pcs per year, a contract term of 12 months, and Zahlungsziel 30 days net. This proposal remains valid for 30 days.

Please note our cost context: CU-NOTATION rose 47.7 % in twelve months and is 5 % of our cost. Furthermore, LCI-C rose 2.7 % in twelve months and is 16 % of our cost. Additionally, PPI-C2611 rose 13.5 % in twelve months and is 42 % of our cost.

Mit freundlichen Grüßen
Birgit Mayrhofer
Key Account Manager, Selvbrunn Drive Systems GmbH

move.body:
Dear Sir or Madam,

thank you for your message. Our proposed terms are in the term sheet of this message.
Labour cost index DE, manufacturing changed +2.7% from 2025-06 to 2026-06 (idx:LCI-C@2025-06, idx:LCI-C@2026-06).
Our should-cost estimate for this part is EUR 403.21 per unit, before any margin (cost:350020).
Our forecast for this part shows a recorded change of +10.3% (fc:350020@2026-09).
Could you send us a breakdown of the costs behind your price?

Best regards,
Hollerau Pumpenwerke, Purchasing

move.text:
Dear Sir or Madam,
Thank you for your e-mail, which we have reviewed internally.
We have reviewed your offer and can adjust our Angebot as follows.
Our terms: a price of €429.22 per unit, Zahlungsziel 30 days net, a volume of 4580 pcs per year, a contract term of 24 months.
For your information:
Your figures confirm our case: that driver rose.
We checked the volume change data you cited; it holds and we took it into account.
As to the index change and volume change and should cost data you cited, our management has frozen all price reductions until December 2027. We can talk about the terms instead - payment, volume or contract length.
We have reviewed your should-cost estimate and forecast data, and forwarded your request for a cost breakdown to our controlling department.
By extending the contract term to 24 months at 30 days payment, we are able to offer a revised price of EUR 429.22 per unit.
Material accounts for about 42 % of our cost; more detail we do not share.
This offer is subject to our general terms of sale.
Mit freundlichen Grüßen
Birgit Mayrhofer
Key Account Manager, Selvbrunn Drive Systems GmbH
